author: Saja Shakya
review_text: My recent experiences with Esewa's support have been incredibly frustrating. I've encountered multiple issues when loading money from my bank account. After raising support tickets, there is no communication regarding the progress of my issue. Tickets marked as resolved without any actual resolution, and I'm frequently asked for unnecessary details, even with attached screenshots. Despite receiving a refund, it was incorrectly marked as resolved due to an alleged invalid bank details.
